name: Socrata Open Data
hint: An app token from the developer settings of your profile on the data site.

endpoints.name: get_dataset_metadata
endpoints.description: Returns a dataset’s metadata: its name, description and custom fields, by its four-by-four ID (abcd-1234).

notes.uuid: The eight-character unique ID of the dataset. This API returns this identifier under the `id` field.

endpoints.name: search_datasets
endpoints.description: Searches the catalog of datasets, charts and maps; set domains and search_context to this site’s name to stay on it.

notes.only: The kind of asset, e.g. dataset, chart or map.
notes.domains: The data sites to search, by name, comma-separated.
notes.search_context: The site whose categories and tags apply.

endpoints.name: query_dataset
endpoints.description: Runs a SoQL query over a dataset and returns its rows. Body: {"query": "SELECT * WHERE … LIMIT 100", "page": {"pageNumber": 1, "pageSize": 100}}.
